task: Build the list of Fibonacci numbers up to 13, that is 1 1 2 3 5 8 13, by writing and evaluating lisp code; store the list as answer. When achieved, evaluate (final true).
lesson: Today I learned `append` requires the accumulator list as the first argument: `(append out new-item)`.

nodes.code: (let ((a 1) (b 1) (out (list))) (while (<= a 13) (set! out (append out (list a))) (set! tmp a) (set! a b) (set! b (+ a tmp))) (rlm-set answer out) (final true))
